sentence: This project tries to predict how combinations of mutations and environmental factors influence biological fitness, using a hypergraph framework.
This project builds mathematical foundations for machine learning methods that use symmetries found in datasets with an emphasis on generative models and equivariant neural networks.
This project combines artificial intelligence and machine learning with geoscience knowledge to understand what causes landslides.
This project builds a control method that lets swarms of unmanned aerial vehicles work together to finish a mission in an unknown environment.
This project uses deep learning to understand and control the responses of plasmonic nanostructures, tiny particles made of gold and silver, to light.
This project builds a system that uses AI to turn natural hand gestures into parametric design commands.
This project uses AI, sensing, and robotics technologies to turn manufacturing systems into data-rich smart and connected systems.
This project plans a large study of the risks and benefits that generative AI systems may pose to security and privacy.
This project combines artificial intelligence with physics-based modeling to track human motion using wearable sensors and smartphone cameras.
This project sets up a cybersecurity clinic that offers free cybersecurity services to local organizations.
This project uses AI techniques for optimizing point-to-point protocols and collective algorithms in Message Passing Interface libraries.
This project studies how peroxisomes and mitochondria move along actin filaments in plant cells, using the small mustard plant Arabidopsis.
This project studies how bacteria process information through gene regulatory networks and uses those ideas to build energy-efficient artificial intelligence for small devices.
This project develops tools that help developers find defects in scientific software and verify that the code is defect-free, using model checking.
This project builds software that finds hidden similarities between long noncoding RNAs, which linear sequence alignment misses.
This research designs an operating system that uses isolation between its components and formal verification to make the kernel more secure and reliable.
This project builds a vision system that lets bird-sized unmanned aerial vehicles navigate unknown cluttered indoor environments using only a camera.
This project builds a miniature soft robotic system that mimics the human eye to keep a laparoscopic camera lens clear during minimally invasive surgeries.
This project develops methods that help teams of aerial and ground robots plan and sense their surroundings together in precision agriculture.
This project builds a framework that learns the beliefs, goals, and control strategies of people, animals, or machines from what they do.
